travel.tips.title: Booking and check-in
travel.tips.book: Before you pay, check the room type, whether breakfast is included and until when you can cancel for free. Keep a screenshot of the confirmed booking to show at the desk.
travel.tips.holiday: Prices rise fastest on public holidays. Once your dates are fixed, book early.
travel.tips.checkin: Bring your passport. In a hotel, the hotel registers your stay for you. If you stay with friends or in a private home, the stay must be registered at the local police station or online within 24 hours (72 hours in the countryside). Before booking a small guesthouse, ask whether it takes guests with a foreign passport.
travel.tips.smoke: If smoke bothers you, ask for a non-smoking room when you book, and again at check-in.
travel.tips.price: In restaurants, ask the price of a dish before ordering, and whether it is priced per portion or by weight.
travel.tips.sources: Based on: Foshan Consumer Council, culture and tourism consumption survey (2024), where 30% of visitors met unreasonable room price rises and nearly 40% unreasonable dish prices; Trip.com 2025 inbound travel survey, as reported in the press; Baidu Baike entries including temporary residence registration.
